I highly recommend going here because the dentist is amazing! She is the only dentist I will go to in Thailand and I’ve lived here six years! She is very gentle and also thorough and does an excellent job, especially knowing that I require a lot of numbing so I don’t feel the drill at all.
Fair pricing for excellent service —highly recommend!

I got my teeth cleaned with air flow and polished and some of my gums was exposing my nerves which was sorted yesterday by the lovely dentist.
She is kind and speaks good English.
I was nervous and she made me feel relaxed and done a very good job.
I paid around 1,800 Thai baht which is about £42. I couldn’t be more pleased with the service I received

Recently had a Wisdom tooth removed here very nice staff, good price, and no pain
I will return. Thank you

I had a small teeth cavity and needed filling done. It was my first time there at the Nai Harn Dental Clinic. The staff were all very nice and friendly. The dentist doctor was super gentle with me. There is no pain after the filling. I would go back to this dentist again. Highly recommended it for anyone. The price is reasonable.

This dental clinic is the best in Phuket.
The dentist that runs it is super professional, and caring about your welfare. She discusses things with you and is not offended if you ask for alternative options.
Similarly she is friendly and very in tune with you - when operating so as to put you at ease. I explained to her I have exaggerated startle response and we subsequently devised a way to ensure this was not a factor.
She cannot be beaten in my opinion for her work; on price - which is more than reasonable - or general professional experience.
If you have not tried here and you need a consultation/dental work you will not find better.

An expat who has lived here 20 years
Ps her team are also all fantastic.
Excellent doctor, I have done many different services here, crowns and veneers and cleaning care, I am very pleased, the staff is very good, the clinic is clean, everything is at a good level🙏👍 …
Clean,  professional and affordable. I had a general clean. Great service.

I went to Nai Harn dental clinic with great expectations and I’m very happy to say I was not disappointed.
I found Dr Sarawut very helpful and easy to work with. She and her staff made me very comfortable and following extensive work over a period of about three weeks, the end product turned out excellent. The new smile I have now has boosted my confidence and I feel better for it.
Thank you very much Dr Sarawut and team.
J Blakiston. Australia
One of the best dental clinics in southern Phuket. My wife and I have used their services for many years.
My wife went here for a checkup and a filling. She said the dentist spoke very good English and she was extremely happy with the service, pricing and friendliness.
Friendly and professional service plus the dentist speaks perfect English. I had a great expierence at Nai Harn Dental Clinic and will definitely go back for my next check-up.
I can definately recommend !! Had a filling done. Very clean. Professional and friendly staff. As I am a very nervous patient, I was treated with so much kindness.
phobic, not seen a dentist since my youth and here I found people who are very attentive and who took the time, super technician and super human 🙏thank you very much🙏 …
The staff is really competent and kind. The prices are fair.
Great staff, really thorough

text: I had my teeth cleaned only 10 weeks ago at Happy Tooth for less.  This dentist said cleaning would be 1000b-1,500b which means 1,500b. I don’t think they charge anyone 1,000b. Cleaning was about 30-40 min. Expensive compared to Happy Tooth.

The equipment was very old. My mouth smelled bad after the cleaning. The dental assistant was sloppy.
Although the cleaning itself was done quite well.

I had two wisdom teeth removed here, one of which was complicated (it impacted the adjacent tooth at a 90-degree angle). The girls did a fantastic job. They were neat, polite, and genuinely Thai. The whole thing cost 6,500 baht, which I think is a very reasonable price. I highly recommend them.
Perfect! State-of-the-art dental care. Painless treatment. Very friendly and highly competent dentist. Thank you so much for the excellent treatment.
The doctor was so kind. She comforted me until I was no longer afraid of needles. She had such a gentle touch.
